title: You can now put your ad inside ChatGPT
direction: Fun, high-energy Instagram skit. Aman: friendly marketing expert, excited, warm, confident. Riya: Indian English, expressive small-brand owner, quick, playful, a little dramatic. Fast natural back-and-forth with real reactions and smiles you can hear.

sections.label: CHATGPT ADS
sections.source: OpenAI announcement, 21 Oct 2026 · screen is an illustration, not the real product

lines.say: You can now put your ad inside ChatGPT.
lines.show: You can now put [your ad] inside [ChatGPT].

lines.say: That's for big brands. I use it for captions!
lines.show: That's for [big brands]. I use it for [captions]!

lines.say: OpenAI says over a hundred thousand advertisers have already run ads there.
lines.show: OpenAI says over [100,000 advertisers] have already run ads there.

lines.say: A hundred thousand? And I'm still boosting posts!

sections.label: WHY IT MATTERS
sections.source: Analogy · OpenAI: ads are "clearly labeled and separate from ChatGPT's answers"

lines.say: Imagine your customer asking a trusted friend: which one should I buy?
lines.show: Imagine your customer asking a [trusted friend]: which one should I buy?

lines.say: And your business card is lying right there.
lines.show: And [your business card] is lying right there.

lines.say: Ohh! So I can show up right when they're deciding!
lines.show: Ohh! So I can show up right when they're [deciding]!

sections.label: THE PRICE
sections.source: India minimum daily budget: OpenAI help centre; TechCrunch, 27 Aug 2026 · about ₹21,750 for 30 days at the minimum

lines.say: And in India, it starts at seven twenty-five rupees a day.
lines.show: And in India, it starts at [₹725 a day].

lines.say: That's my chai budget! I'm putting everything in!
lines.show: That's my chai budget! I'm putting [everything in]!

lines.say: Don't! Test it small. One product, one clear offer.
lines.show: Don't! [Test it small.] One product, one clear offer.

lines.say: Comment CHATGPT. I'll DM you a one-page starter guide.
lines.show: Comment ["CHATGPT"]. I'll DM you a [one-page starter guide].

lines.say: Sending this to my partner. Not my competitor.
lines.show: Sending this to my partner. [Not my competitor.] 🤫

items.share: Send this to a founder before their competitor sees it 👀
